sources.note: Nothing. Lipo syllable = C+V+Tone; four tones (55, 33, 21, 21 creaky with final glottal stop); inventories and allophony only. No mention of stress/accent anywhere in the scanned phonology chapter (pp. 26-80).

sources.citation: Gao, Katie B. 2017. Dynamics of Language Contact in China: Ethnolinguistic Diversity and Variation in Yunnan. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa (sec. 2.4.2.2 Central Ngwi: Lipo, Miqie, Lolo, Geipo; appendix wordlists with Lipo column).

sources.note: Nothing; Dayao Lipo has 37 initials, 35 vowels, 3 tones (55, 33, 21); no word 'stress' in the linguistic sense anywhere in the dissertation.
